item.title: INMO Reports Over 50 Patients Awaiting Beds at Local Hospitals
item.description: There were over 50 patients waiting for a bed at local hospitals this morning. That's according to the INMO's latest trolley watch report. Thursday's figures show there 31 patients waiting in Sligo University Hospital. Advertisement This included 20 in the emergency department and 11 on wards elsewhere. item.title: €100,000 Scratchcard Win for Lucky Roscommon Customer
item.description: One lucky customer in Roscommon has had a fantastic start to the new year after scooping €100,000 on a scratchcard. The National Lottery Christmas Countdown scratchcard was sold in Keane's Centra in Athleague. The shop has taken to social media to congratulate the winner, who is remaining anonymous. Advertisement A post on Facebook said they hoped the lucky punter really enjoyed their win.

item.title: Man released in Edenderry arson probe
item.description: A man arrested in connection with an arson attack that killed a boy and his grand aunt in Offaly last month has been released without charge. Gardaí say a file will be prepared for the director of public prosecutions. Four year old Tadhg Farrell and his grand-aunt Mary Holt were killed in the blaze at Castleview Park in Edenderry on December 6th. item.title: IABA becomes Boxing Ireland
item.description: The famous IABA name has disappeared as Boxing Ireland is the new name for Irish boxing. The Irish Athletic Boxing Association (IABA) becomes Boxing Ireland, marking a transformational milestone for the sport and the beginning of a powerful new era of visibility, engagement and commercial growth for Ireland’s most successful Olympic sport. item.title: Ministers Revenue debacle continues
item.description: A number of Government Ministers are querying the amount of money they may owe Revenue after a payment error. Sinn Féin's Pearse Doherty criticised the ten Ministers who haven't paid the money back after the mistake was revealed seven months ago. He said civil servants affected by the same issue had been pursued by Revenue for smaller amounts owed. item.title: Over €1 million on the way to Strokestown House
item.description: The Irish Heritage Trust has announced plans for a new nature-based outdoor experience at Strokestown Park. Around €1.2m worth of funding has been allocated to the popular local tourist attraction. The project has been funded under the Just Transition Fund through Fáilte Ireland, Westward Holdings and The Irish Heritage Trust. item.title: Minister Norma Foley to visit Longford
item.description: A new Family Resource Centre will be top of the agenda when the Minister for Children and Disabilities visits Longford next week. Minister Norma Foley will visit the proposed site for the facility next Thursday. Longford missed out last year when it was confirmed it wouldn't be one of five locations for a new FRC. item.title: Three hospitalised following Leitrim crash
item.description: Three people have been taken to hospital following a crash in county Leitrim. Gardaí and emergency services attended the scene of the three-vehicle collision which happened on the R209 at Kilclare on Thursday evening. The incident occurred at around 5.20pm. Advertisement Gardaí say that three people were taken to Sligo University Hospital hospital for injuries, which are believed to be non-life threatening. Investigations are continuing.
